Maharashtra Cabinet Sub-Committee Approves ₹1,722 Crore Road Project

A Maharashtra cabinet sub-committee has approved a road project valued at ₹1,722 crore. This project is identified as the Versova-Bandra Sea Link or Bandra Fort Connector. Additionally, the Maharashtra government has also approved an extension for the Nagpur Metro. These decisions were made by the cabinet sub-committee and the government respectively.
